# PAAS-004: No platform database is published publicly

- **Group:** Coolify and Dokploy
- **Severity when it fails:** critical
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Both platforms offer a "publicly available" switch on databases that publishes the port on every interface. Docker publishes past UFW, so the database is open to the internet and to password guessing and known exploits.

## Verify by hand

```sh
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Ports}}' | grep -Ei 'postgres|mysql|maria|mongo|redis|valkey|clickhouse'
```

## How to fix it

Turn off "publicly available" for the database and reach it over the tailnet or an SSH tunnel.

## What a fix can break

Clients that connect over the public port lose access until they use the private path.

Run `stackward explain PAAS-004` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
